subject: Phase 100300: Rerank Provider Adapters (TEI and Cohere-Compatible)
verdict_justification: Phase 100300 cleanly implements the Cohere-compatible reranker adapter (CohereReranker), factory selection (build_reranker and build_reranker_from), and comprehensive unit and contract tests while preserving TEI behavior, fail-open orchestration semantics, and strict file size and coverage constraints. Only three minor non-blocking items were identified regarding URL path suffix flexibility, pre-existing HttpReranker debug token masking, and keyless local proxy usage.

findings.title: Potential double '/v1' path if RERANK_URL contains '/v1' suffix
findings.recommendation: In CohereReranker::rerank, strip any trailing '/v1' before appending '/v1/rerank' (e.g. self.url.trim_end_matches('/').strip_suffix("/v1").unwrap_or(...)) to gracefully tolerate operators passing RERANK_URL=https://api.cohere.com/v1.

findings.title: HttpReranker derived Debug leaks bearer token if printed
findings.evidence: crates/clio-retrieve/src/rerank.rs:61-66 (#[derive(Debug)] pub struct HttpReranker { url: String, bearer: Option<String>, ... })
findings.recommendation: Implement a manual fmt::Debug for HttpReranker redacting the bearer token as '****', matching CohereReranker's implementation.

findings.title: build_reranker_from strictly requires credentials for Cohere provider, blocking keyless local proxies
findings.evidence: crates/clio-retrieve/src/rerank.rs:250-255 (let Some(key) = bearer else { return Err(AmError::new(ErrorCode::ConfigCorrupt, "rerank.provider = cohere requires credentials...")); };)
findings.recommendation: Document or relax the bearer requirement in build_reranker_from if local unauthenticated Cohere-compatible sidecars (such as Infinity or Ollama) become a supported deployment option.

issues.title: Potential double '/v1' path if RERANK_URL contains '/v1' suffix
issues.why_it_matters: Operators accustomed to OpenAI base URLs (like https://api.openai.com/v1) or following zero-deps.md examples might set RERANK_URL with a /v1 suffix, causing requests to target /v1/v1/rerank and fail.
issues.impact: Configuring RERANK_URL with trailing /v1 results in 404 Not Found from providers unless explicitly configured without /v1.
issues.proposed_fix: Strip trailing '/v1' from the base URL before appending '/v1/rerank', or document the strict root domain requirement in .env.example.

issues.title: HttpReranker derived Debug leaks bearer token if printed
issues.why_it_matters: While CohereReranker provides a custom fmt::Debug implementation that redacts bearer tokens, HttpReranker still derives Debug, meaning any debug formatting of the TEI reranker client could expose bearer tokens in logs.
issues.impact: Low risk for local sidecars which typically do not use bearer tokens, but violates defense-in-depth credential masking for authenticated TEI proxies.
issues.proposed_fix: Replace #[derive(Debug)] on HttpReranker with a manual fmt::Debug implementation masking self.bearer as '****'.

issues.title: build_reranker_from strictly requires credentials for Cohere provider, blocking keyless local proxies
issues.why_it_matters: Local self-hosted rerank engines (e.g. Infinity, TEI with Cohere API emulation, or local proxies) running Cohere wire format often require no authentication.
issues.impact: Operators cannot use local Cohere-compatible endpoints without supplying a dummy API key.
issues.proposed_fix: Allow Optional bearer in build_reranker_from for provider = cohere when the endpoint is unauthenticated local http.
